item.title: Combiner 0.23.0
item.description:
• Nothing renders by itself any more. The background render settings are greyed out and coming in a later version; Render All still runs when you click it.
  • The best way to get a wet stem: bounce the track in place in your DAW and it shows up in Combiner on its own. The "How sharing works" guide now says so.
  • The largest file that goes over the internet is 200 MB (50, 100 or 200 MB in the settings). On the same network there is still no limit.
  • A drop of files adds up to 1 GB at most.
  • Join takes whole room codes only: 8 characters, or a room you have been in before.
  • Slow uploads are no longer cut off part way through.
